common.term: {months, plural, one {for the next # month} other {for the next # months}}

auto.subject: Reminder: your subscription renews soon
auto.body: {when, select, dated {On {date}} other {Soon}} we will automatically charge {price} for the {name} subscription{term}. You do not need to do anything — we are writing only so the charge on your statement comes as no surprise.
auto.change: If you would like to change or cancel your plan, there is still time until then:

manual.subject: Your subscription ends soon
manual.body: the subscription for {name} ends {when, select, dated {on {date}} other {soon}}. We have no card on file, so it will not renew automatically — to keep the posts coming, please renew your plan manually:

charge_failed.subject: Your Chrlit payment failed
charge_failed.body: we could not charge the automatic payment{hasPrice, select, yes { of {price}} other {}} for the {name} subscription{attempt, plural, =0 {} other { (attempt # of {max})}}. We will try again tomorrow — please check your payment card, or renew the plan manually:

manual_renew.subject: Renew your Chrlit subscription
manual_renew.body: the subscription for {name} has just ended. To keep the posts coming without interruption, please renew your plan with one click:

expired.subject: Your Chrlit subscription has expired
expired.body: the subscription for {name} has expired. Your data, brand and learned preferences are kept; generation resumes as soon as you renew the plan:

payment_recovered.subject: Payment received — everything is back in order
payment_recovered.body: the payment for {name} went through after all and your subscription continues without interruption. There is nothing else you need to do.

generation_failed.subject: One post could not be generated
generation_failed.body: {hasWhat, select, yes {{what} could} other {One of the scheduled posts for {name} could}} not be generated.{hasReason, select, yes { Reason: {reason}.} other {}}
generation_failed.retry: We will retry automatically on the next run — you do not need to do anything. If it happens again, we will get in touch.

facts_pending.subject: {count, plural, one {# post is} other {# posts are}} waiting for fact verification
facts_pending.body: {name} has {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} with a claim that is not backed by verified facts — a number, a year, a warranty or a technical parameter, for example. {count, plural, one {It} other {They}} will not go out automatically: this is exactly the kind of detail you are accountable for, not us.
facts_pending.howTo: In the studio you will see which claim it is. Either confirm it with one click (it is saved among verified facts) or delete it from the text — {count, plural, one {the post} other {the posts}} will then go out at the next slot.

publish_failed.subject: A scheduled post could not be published
publish_failed.body: {hasWhat, select, yes {{what}} other {the scheduled post for {name}}} could not be published to Instagram even after repeated attempts.{hasReason, select, yes { Reason: {reason}.} other {}}
publish_failed.next: The post is ready and waiting in the calendar — the most common cause is a disconnected or expired Instagram account. Just reconnect it and release the post:

activation_nudge.subject: Your content is waiting — launch your first campaign
activation_nudge.body: you signed up for Chrlit{hasBrand, select, yes { with the brand {brand}} other {}}, but no campaign of your own has run yet. Sample posts are waiting for you in the studio.
activation_nudge.next: One click is all it takes and we will prepare a full week of content — copy, images, calendar.

credit_low.subject: Credits almost used up
credit_low.body: the plan{hasBrand, select, yes { for {brand}} other {}} has {remaining} of {total, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} left. To keep the content coming, please upgrade your plan or top up credits.

winback.subject: Your Instagram has gone quiet — come back to Chrlit
winback.body: the subscription{hasBrand, select, yes { for {brand}} other {}} has expired and the account has stopped receiving new content. Your settings, brand and learned preferences are saved — coming back is a single click.

dormant.subject: Your Instagram is a few clicks away from another week of content
dormant.body: no new post has been created{hasBrand, select, yes { for {brand}} other {}} in the last two weeks — and an account that stops publishing loses reach faster than it can win it back.
dormant.next: Your brand and learned preferences are saved, so a weekly plan takes one click.

ig_disconnected.subject: Your Instagram connection needs to be renewed
ig_disconnected.body: the account{hasBrand, select, yes { of {brand}} other {}} has no working Instagram connection — access from Meta expires over time and needs to be confirmed every now and then.
ig_disconnected.next: While it is disconnected, posts are still generated but have nowhere to be published. Reconnecting takes two clicks:

waitlist_drip.subject: We have not forgotten you
waitlist_drip.body: you are on the Chrlit Studio waiting list. We let people in gradually so that every new account gets the full quality — the next wave of invitations is on its way.
waitlist_drip.next: Thanks for your patience. We will be in touch as soon as it is your turn.
